userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $p = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { $p = "python" }; & $p scripts\spendlens.py prompt copilot
$p = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { $p = "python" }; & $p scripts\handoff.py arm copilot

preToolUse.powershell: $p = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { $p = "python" }; & $p scripts\diet.py copilot

postToolUse.powershell: $p = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { $p = "python" }; & $p scripts\spendlens.py tool copilot

sessionEnd.powershell: $p = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { $p = "python" }; & $p scripts\spendlens.py finalize copilot
$p = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { $p = "python" }; & $p scripts\handoff.py end copilot
